blind.description: A traditional wooden mantel clock with an arched casing, decorative molded base, circular cream-colored dial with hands and a gold bezel, four rounded brass ball feet, and a brass ring handle on top. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, melting, or missing geometry.
blind.from_above: A small rectangular brown block with stepped molded edges and a gold ring handle protruding at the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1/5 to 1/6 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 1 to 1.2 feet tall), and about 1 foot wide.
